featured_reviews.name: Jainam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this to warn everyone about the severe lack of safety and basic humanity at Roxy Cinema. Yesterday, my mother attended the 10 PM show of 'Dhabkaaro'. As the crowd was exiting the lift, a heavy ceiling tile suddenly collapsed and fell onto the people below. Two people were injured badly and bleeding, and heavy tile pieces hit my mother's head.
While accidents can happen, the theatre staff's reaction was absolutely disgusting. They were completely uncooperative. Nobody stepped forward to offer basic first aid, medical support, or even a glass of water to the bleeding and injured patrons. We had to literally shout and threaten to call the police just to get them to act, and even then, they helped completely half-heartedly.
We are now dealing with significant medical expenses, and the theatre management hasn't even had the decency to offer a simple apology. They clearly do not care about the safety or lives of their customers. Avoid this theatre at all costs unless you want to put your life at risk.

featured_reviews.name: Kunal Phadnis
featured_reviews.review_text:
Roxy Cinemas, Charni Road is an Art Deco-style single-screen theater located in South Mumbai. While it offers a nostalgic and budget-friendly movie-going experience, recent reviews suggest that the quality of its facilities has significantly declined over time.
Affordable ticket pricing makes it a popular spot for college students and families looking for a low-cost outing.
Many visitors praise the sound quality and screen clarity, noting that it provides a decent viewing experience despite being an older venue.
The seating is frequently criticized for being torn, uncomfortable, or poorly maintained, with some reviewers noting a lack of cleanliness in the auditorium.
Management issues are a common theme in complaints, specifically regarding long exit processes, unhelpful staff, and unsanitary restroom conditions.
The food court offers classic cinema snacks like popcorn and samosas, though some guests find the pricing to be high relative to the theater's overall quality.
Overall, it is a suitable choice

featured_reviews.name: Stringzzz
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Metro INOX Cinema, and my overall experience was extremely enjoyable and comfortable. This cinema hall perfectly blends a classic feel with modern movie-watching amenities, making it a great choice for both regular viewers and cinema lovers who appreciate a well-maintained theatre.

The screen and sound quality were excellent. The visuals were sharp, bright, and immersive, which made the movie even more engaging. The sound system was well balanced—loud enough to create impact without being overwhelming. Dialogues were clear, and background music and effects were crisp, enhancing the overall cinematic experience.

The seating arrangement deserves special mention. The seats were comfortable, well-spaced, and offered a clear view of the screen from almost every angle. Legroom was sufficient, allowing for a relaxed experience even during a long movie. The auditorium was clean and well maintained, which added to the comfort level.

The ambience of Metro INOX has a pleasant and premium feel. The lobby area was neat, organized, and not overly crowded. The lighting and interiors give a classy vibe, making the wait time before the show quite comfortable. Entry and exit were well managed, avoiding unnecessary rush or confusion.

Food and beverages were also satisfactory. The snacks counter offered the usual cinema favourites like popcorn, cold drinks, and nachos. While prices are on the higher side—as expected in multiplexes—the quality and freshness were good. The staff at the counter were polite and quick in handling orders, even during peak hours.

Another positive aspect was the staff behavior and overall management. The staff members were helpful, courteous, and ensured smooth operations throughout the show. Ticket checking, seating guidance, and cleanliness were handled efficiently. Restrooms were clean and well maintained, which is an important factor for any public place.

Overall, Metro INOX Cinema provides a reliable, comfortable, and enjoyable movie-watching experience. Whether you’re going for a weekend show with friends, a family outing, or a solo movie break, this place delivers on quality, comfort, and ambience. I would definitely recommend Metro INOX Cinema to anyone looking for a pleasant and hassle-free cinema experience.

featured_reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed my visit to Metro INOX Cinema!  The theater is incredibly well maintained, which made for a super comfortable and pleasant experience. Definitely a top spot for movie nights!

featured_reviews.name: DHANESH PATIDAR
featured_reviews.review_text: Metro INOX at Marine Lines is a standout cinema that beautifully blends Art Deco heritage with modern luxury, offering a visual treat before the movie even starts. The viewing experience is top-tier, featuring crisp Laser projection and immersive Dolby Atmos sound, while the Insignia screens provide unmatched comfort with recliner seating and butler service. However, this premium experience comes with South Mumbai pricing for tickets and food, and the biggest drawback is the severe lack of parking, often forcing patrons to use distant pay-and-park slots. Overall, it is a perfect spot for a lavish movie date or a special night out if you arrive by cab, but a logistical headache if you plan to drive.

featured_reviews.name: Naihrit Halder
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Eros IMAX, Mumbai, and it ended up being one of my favourite movie experiences in the city. There’s something special about this place—the moment you see the iconic art‑deco building from outside, it already feels different from the typical multiplex vibe.
Inside, the theatre is spacious, clean, and surprisingly comfortable. The IMAX screen here genuinely enhances the movie experience without overwhelming you, and the sound quality is crystal clear. I watched a film here recently, and the visuals + audio made it feel so immersive.
One thing I really appreciate about Eros is how well-organized everything is—from the ticket counters to entering the auditorium. The staff was polite and helpful, and the crowd felt more relaxed compared to the usual rush you see in other cinemas.
Snacks are priced reasonably for a theatre in South Mumbai, and the washrooms and waiting areas are clean and well-maintained.
Plus, walking out after the show into the Churchgate/Marine Drive area just completes the whole experience. It’s one of the few cinemas where both the movie and the location feel equally enjoyable.
Definitely a great spot for movie lovers. I’d happily visit again!

featured_reviews.name: ARYAN PATIL
featured_reviews.review_text: Watched a movie at Eros INOX and had a great experience overall. The screen quality is excellent with sharp visuals, and the sound system is immersive, making the movie truly engaging. Seating is comfortable with good legroom, so even long movies feel relaxed. The theatre is clean, well maintained, and the staff is organized, which makes entry and exit smooth. Definitely one of the better places in the city to enjoy a movie.

featured_reviews.name: Arjun Pitroda
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an incredible experience at Eros INOX! I’ve watched two IMAX movies here recently and both were spectacular. The restoration is stunning—they’ve kept the classic Art Deco charm and those iconic marble stairs, but the theater itself is world-class. The IMAX with Laser technology is super sharp, and the sound is immersive without being overwhelming. It’s easily one of the best places in Mumbai to catch a blockbuster. Highly recommend for the nostalgia and the tech!

A Stunning Revival of a Mumbai Icon!

I recently visited the newly revamped Eros Theatre at Churchgate, now under the PVR banner and featuring a grand IMAX screen. I must say, the experience was nothing short of spectacular.

The restoration has beautifully retained the Art Deco charm of this iconic building, blending heritage with modern technology seamlessly. From the moment you enter, the space exudes elegance and nostalgia, yet feels fresh and world-class.

The IMAX screen is massive and immersive, and the sound system is crystal clear, delivering every note and dialogue with incredible depth. Seats are comfortable, the ambience is premium, and the entire setup does justice to both classic cinema lovers and modern moviegoers.

Kudos to PVR for respecting the legacy of Eros while transforming it into a state-of-the-art cinema destination. If you’re in Mumbai and love movies, this place is an absolute must-visit!

The transformation into a new-age multiplex may not be ultra-luxury, but it is decent, functional, and surprisingly pleasant.

We visited mainly for nostalgia, and honestly, we were pleasantly surprised. The theatre has been modernized while still carrying echoes of its past charm. Seating, sound, and screen quality are good enough for a comfortable movie experience—nothing extraordinary, but definitely not disappointing.

Ticket prices and food & beverage rates are modest and reasonable, which makes it a great option for casual moviegoers. Overall, Mukta A2 has done a fair job reviving an old Mumbai classic. It’s not too great, not too bad—just a simple, honest cinema experience that feels welcoming and familiar.

A nice balance of nostalgia and practicality. 🎬

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Aher
featured_reviews.review_text:
🎬 INOX IMAX – R City Mall, Ghatkopar | Honest IMAX Experience Review

I recently watched an IMAX screening at INOX IMAX R City Mall, and here’s a clear, no-nonsense review based on the actual experience.

Overall Experience: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5)

What Works Well:
•	IMAX scale & immersion: The auditorium delivers the signature IMAX feel with a massive screen and powerful surround sound, making it a good choice for big-budget, visually heavy films.
•	Comfortable environment: The hall is clean, well-maintained, and acoustics are solid, especially for action and background scores.
•	Location advantage: Being inside R City Mall makes it convenient with ample food and parking options.

What Could Be Better:
•	Projection quality (3D): While watching Avatar: Fire and Ash in 3D, the visuals felt noticeably blurred. A laser IMAX projection would have significantly improved sharpness, brightness, and depth.
•	Seats: The seating is decent but not premium. For long IMAX movies, better cushioning and ergonomics would enhance comfort.
•	3D clarity: Fast-moving scenes lacked crispness, which slightly broke immersion—something you don’t expect from an IMAX-branded screen.

Final Verdict:
INOX IMAX R City Mall is good for IMAX movies, especially if you value screen size and sound, but it falls short of a true next-gen IMAX experience due to the non-laser projection and average seating. Upgrade to laser projection and better seats, and this could easily become one of Mumbai’s top IMAX destinations.

Recommended for: Big action / spectacle films
Not ideal for: Viewers sensitive to 3D blur or expecting laser-sharp visuals

Speaking of popcorn — I paid ₹460 for one serving and ₹70 for a half-litre bottle of mineral water. Including my travel, I spent around ₹1,500 just to watch a movie.

featured_reviews.review_text:
My visit to INOX Neelyog in Ghatkopar East was a bit of a mixed experience. While the theatre itself is okay, it feels like a bit of a deserted venue. The mall it’s located in is quite old, and despite being owned by PVR-INOX, the place feels stuck in time, lacking the modern amenities you’d expect from their brand. It doesn’t have the same fresh, updated atmosphere as other PVR-INOX theatres.

Its proximity to the Ghatkopar Railway Station makes it a convenient choice for moviegoers relying on public transport.

The seating was decent, but there was nothing exceptional about it. The overall maintenance seemed lacking, and the place just felt a bit neglected. The staff were polite, but the overall service felt a bit lackluster, especially when compared to other PVR-INOX theatres. The staff seemed understaffed, and there were minor delays in service, particularly at the concession stand. As for maintenance, it was evident that the theatre could use some attention. The cleanliness in the common areas and washrooms was below par, and the seats, though functional, showed signs of wear and tear.

The ticket prices were reasonable, but when compared to other PVR-INOX theatres, this one doesn’t justify the price for the experience it offers. Snacks were also the standard fare, but the portions were smaller, and they didn’t feel as fresh.

In summary, while it wasn’t a terrible experience, it felt more like a theatre stuck in the past, lacking the vibrant and well-maintained vibe you’d expect from a PVR-INOX property. It’s good if you're in the area, but I wouldn’t go out of my way for it.
